opening.argument: The video actively promotes the DTX Exchange presale by presenting an exceptional 2400% return as a reason to participate. It describes the DTX coin as available for purchase at 4 cents before a stated 12-cent launch, reports predictions that it could reach $1 and beyond, and directs viewers to click the description link to start investing. These claims combine a presale fundraising appeal, extraordinary appreciation forecasts, and an explicit purchase instruction. The material is promotional rather than reporting or testing a third-party scam, making the token purchase and anticipated appreciation the central basis for participation.
